description: Questions about the Riverside Library sample report. 'expect' strings must all appear in a correct answer (case-insensitive, commas in numbers ignored). 'pages' are 1-based pages where the answer is printed. Unanswerable questions check that the system says the document doesn't cover them instead of guessing.
